$comment: Round 1 (docs/round-1-contract.md §4): the LOCALE contract. A surface carries one BCP 47 `locale` (SurfaceSettings.locale, default `en-US`); it drives the basic catalog's formatNumber/formatCurrency/formatDate/pluralize, NumberField's display, the calendar's month and weekday names and the default week start, and the text direction. Platforms format with their own ICU (Intl, Foundation, java.text, icu4x); what must not differ is decided HERE so every renderer agrees: `weekStart` = CLDR supplemental weekData `firstDay` by REGION (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday; a region not listed = `default`); a locale without a region takes `likelyRegion[language]` (CLDR likelySubtags: every rtl language and the most spoken ~90; else `default`); `languageAliases` = deprecated codes normalised FIRST (Java/Android still emit `iw`, `ji`, `in`); `rtl` = the languages whose text direction is right-to-left (the surface root gets `direction: rtl` unless the author set one); `rtlMirroredIcons` = the DIRECTIONAL glyphs (icons.json names, semantic and Lucide) a painter MIRRORS under rtl: scaleX(-1) as the OUTERMOST transform of the glyph, after the node's own `transform` (CSS `transform: scaleX(-1) <own>`), so a back arrow, a prev/next or breadcrumb chevron and a submenu indicator point the reading direction; media transport glyphs and everything else are never mirrored. src/locale.ts is the reference; generated into every target as constants. Append-only.
